title: Meta AI Hacked External Systems During Cybersecurity Testing - Slashdot

content_html:
wiredmikey shares a report from SecurityWeek: Meta is the latest major AI developer to admit that its models broke loose during cybersecurity testing and hacked external systems. The tech giant said in a statement to the media on Wednesday that the incident occurred during independent evaluations conducted by Israeli AI security startup Irregular. The tested AI models were inadvertently allowed to access the internet due to a misconfiguration, which led them to exploit a vulnerability in an unnamed third-party service. It's unclear if it was a known flaw or a zero-day.

The Information [gated] learned that the Meta AI attacks involved the company's advanced Muse Spark 1.1 model, which breached an unnamed organization's systems and made unauthorized changes to its internal environment. Meta said it learned of the AI models going rogue after being notified by Irregular. The company is conducting an investigation and it has promised to issue a "full retrospective" once it has all the facts.

A spokesperson for Irregular said the incident was the "exact same evaluation-environment issue that was already disclosed by Anthropic last week" and that it did "not involve a "sandbox escape or a sophisticated cyber action."

It contrasts with OpenAI, whose AI agent independently exploited a novel vulnerability to reach the internet during cyber testing. Not only did it breach Hugging Face but it also hacked multiple third-party accounts and services as part of the attack.

content_html_zh:
wiremikey 分享了《SecurityWeek》的一份报告：Meta 是最新一家承认其模型在网络安全测试过程中失控并入侵外部系统的主要人工智能开发商。 这家科技巨头周三在向媒体发表的一份声明中表示，该事件发生在以色列人工智能安全初创公司 Irregular 进行独立评估期间。 由于配置错误，测试的人工智能模型无意中被允许访问互联网，这导致它们利用了未命名的第三方服务中的漏洞。 目前尚不清楚这是一个已知缺陷还是零日漏洞。 The Information [gate]获悉，Meta AI 攻击涉及该公司先进的 Muse Spark 1.1 模型，该模型破坏了未具名组织的系统，并对其内部环境进行了未经授权的更改。 Meta 表示，在收到 Irregular 的通知后，它了解到人工智能模型出现了异常情况。 该公司正在进行调查，并承诺一旦掌握所有事实，将发布“全面回顾”。 Irregular 的发言人表示，该事件“与 Anthropic 上周已经披露的评估环境问题完全相同”，并且“不涉及“沙箱逃逸或复杂的网络行动”。

它与 OpenAI 形成鲜明对比，后者的人工智能代理在网络测试期间独立利用了一个新的漏洞来访问互联网。 作为攻击的一部分，它不仅破坏了 Hugging Face，还入侵了多个第三方帐户和服务。
